title: The Lighthouse Blueprint Leak
intro: The keeper's secret plan for a new foghorn has vanished from the lighthouse office, and someone on the rocky cape knows more than they admit.

suspects.name: Marlow
suspects.line: I only came up for the view, I swear on my fishing hat.

suspects.name: Tomas
suspects.line: Fixing the gate all day. Hands were busy, ask anyone.

suspects.name: Oswin
suspects.line: Foghorns? Bah. In my day we just shouted.

suspects.name: Juniper
suspects.line: I brought my dog. He has an alibi too, probably.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was sketching gulls all afternoon. Ask my notebook.

clues.text: A dropped fishing net lies here, but its owner was not carrying it at the time of the theft. The net is cleared of any link to the missing plans.
Wet footprints on the lighthouse steps match no one's trail, so the culprit was not last seen there. Whoever climbed these steps left by a different path.
A gull-watcher saw someone last seen heading out along the harbour wall just before dusk. The figure was lingering near the water's edge.
A smudged print shows the culprit was carrying a tin lantern when they slipped in. The lantern's dented rim left a mark on the doorframe.
